participation.context: Wrote the waking out of order, and put the leaf underneath.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the waking is for his mouth, and not played today

story.body: You put the weaver's failure on the leaf in prose, said the line aloud, and left the queen unwritten on top of it. You did not close the play.

relations.note: the waking is for his mouth, and not played today

participation.context: Placed the leaf underneath, and left the top sheet for later.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: a waking written for him, not yet spoken by him

story.body: You left the line visible long enough to see it, then put the leaf under the pile. You did not count what was above it.

relations.note: a waking written for him, not yet spoken by him

title: Put the leaf under the other sheets

participation.context: Tried the cadence twice, kept the third, and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: the waking is his to say

story.body: You tried the waking twice in his cadence and both times it was still yours. The third time you stopped and called it his. You left the queen for another night.

relations.note: the waking is his to say

title: Stopped on the third try and called the line Kemp's
